overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: members timely certified within two weeks of the October 14, 2025 oath, which is the qualification date, and no separate subcommittee certification was required.

allegations.summary: Complaint said subcommittee members missed the two-week OML certification deadline, counting from the July 22, 2025 appointment rather than the October 14 oath.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, where Subcommittee members certified receipt of the Open Meeting Law materials within two weeks of October 14, 2025, we find that the members complied with the Open Meeting Law’s certification provisions.

allegations.summary: Complaint said two members who certified as School Committee members did not separately certify as subcommittee members.
allegations.key_passage: A public body member does not need to sign a separate certification when joining a subcommittee of the public body.
